questions.question: What is the expected major product when Acetaldehyde (2 equiv) is treated with Dilute NaOH (0°C)?
questions.explanation: Treating Acetaldehyde (2 equiv) with Dilute NaOH (0°C) yields 3-Hydroxybutanal (aldol product). Rationale: Enolate of acetaldehyde attacks another acetaldehyde molecule to form beta-hydroxy aldehyde.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Acetaldehyde (2 equiv) into 2-Butenal (crotonaldehyde) + H2O?
questions.explanation: To convert Acetaldehyde (2 equiv) into 2-Butenal (crotonaldehyde) + H2O, the appropriate reagent is NaOH in H2O / heat. Rationale: Base-promoted E1cB dehydration of beta-hydroxy aldehyde forms conjugated alpha,beta-unsaturated enal.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Benzaldehyde + Acetone is treated with Sodium hydroxide in ethanol / H2O?
questions.explanation: Treating Benzaldehyde + Acetone with Sodium hydroxide in ethanol / H2O yields 4-Phenyl-3-buten-2-one (benzalacetone). Rationale: Benzaldehyde has no alpha-hydrogens and is more electrophilic, reacting cleanly with acetone enolate.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 2,6-Heptanedione into 3-Methyl-2-cyclohexen-1-one?
questions.explanation: To convert 2,6-Heptanedione into 3-Methyl-2-cyclohexen-1-one, the appropriate reagent is Aqueous NaOH / heat. Rationale: Intramolecular enolate attack on the remaining carbonyl cyclizes selectively to form a stable 6-membered enone.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Ethyl acetate (2 equiv) is treated with 1. Sodium ethoxide (NaOEt) in ethanol; 2. H3O+?
questions.explanation: Treating Ethyl acetate (2 equiv) with 1. Sodium ethoxide (NaOEt) in ethanol; 2. H3O+ yields Ethyl acetoacetate (beta-keto ester) + Ethanol. Rationale: Ester enolate attacks second ester molecule; deprotonation of beta-keto ester drives reaction to completion.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Diethyl hexanedioate (diethyl adipate) into Ethyl 2-oxocyclopentanecarboxylate?
questions.explanation: To convert Diethyl hexanedioate (diethyl adipate) into Ethyl 2-oxocyclopentanecarboxylate, the appropriate reagent is 1. NaOEt in ethanol; 2. H3O+. Rationale: Intramolecular ester condensation forms a stable 5-membered cyclic beta-keto ester.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with 1. NaOEt in ethanol; 2. H3O+ to yield Ethyl benzoylacetate + Ethanol as the major product?
questions.explanation: Ethyl benzoate + Ethyl acetate reacts with 1. NaOEt in ethanol; 2. H3O+ to yield Ethyl benzoylacetate + Ethanol. Rationale: Non-enolizable ethyl benzoate is attacked by ethyl acetate enolate, forming a beta-keto ester.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Diethyl malonate + 2-Cyclohexen-1-one is treated with Catalytic sodium ethoxide in ethanol?
questions.explanation: Treating Diethyl malonate + 2-Cyclohexen-1-one with Catalytic sodium ethoxide in ethanol yields Diethyl 2-(3-oxocyclohexyl)malonate. Rationale: Stabilized dicarbonyl enolate (Michael donor) undergoes 1,4-addition to alpha,beta-unsaturated ketone (acceptor).

questions.question: Which starting material will react with 1. Acrylonitrile (H2C=CHCN); 2. H3O+ to yield 3-(2-Oxocyclohexyl)propanenitrile as the major product?
questions.explanation: 1-(Pyrrolidin-1-yl)cyclohexene reacts with 1. Acrylonitrile (H2C=CHCN); 2. H3O+ to yield 3-(2-Oxocyclohexyl)propanenitrile. Rationale: Enamine nucleophile performs soft 1,4-addition to electron-deficient alkene; hydrolysis restores ketone.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when 2-Methylcyclohexanone + Methyl vinyl ketone is treated with Sodium ethoxide in ethanol / heat?
questions.explanation: Treating 2-Methylcyclohexanone + Methyl vinyl ketone with Sodium ethoxide in ethanol / heat yields 4a-Methyl-4,4a,5,6,7,8-hexahydronaphthalen-2(3H)-one. Rationale: Tandem Michael conjugate addition followed by intramolecular aldol condensation builds a fused bicyclic ring.
